tools.name: check_nursing_home
tools.description: The inspection and penalty record of one U.S. nursing home from CMS data: star ratings, staffing, fines and payment denials, how many inspection citations it has (and how many at the actual-harm or immediate-jeopardy level), its most recent citations with dates, its chain and its owner organisations

tools.name: search_nursing_homes
tools.description: List Medicare and Medicaid certified nursing homes by name, city or state, highest CMS overall rating first, with each home's rating, beds, special-focus status and abuse flag. Use check_nursing_home for one home's full record.

tools.name: search_recalls
tools.description: Search U.S. recalls by product words and/or company: FDA food, drug and medical-device recalls (enforcement reports) and CPSC consumer-product recalls. tools.name: find_trials
tools.description: Find clinical studies registered on ClinicalTrials.gov by condition, sponsor or intervention, optionally by status (e.g. RECRUITING), phase (1-4), U.S. state or country. Returns status, phase, sponsor, dates, enrolment and the registry link. Pass nct_id for one study. Registry facts only, no advice

tools.name: aircraft_owner
tools.description: Look up a U.S. civil aircraft in the FAA registry by tail number (N-number) or Mode S hex code: make, model, year, registration status and dates, and the registrant when it is an organisation (company, LLC, government). tools.name: tariff_duty
tools.description: The U.S. import duty on an HTS line for goods from a given country on a given date, read from the USITC schedule in force that day: the general or column 2 base rate, special-program rates, and every additional Chapter 99 duty that reaches the code and country (Section 301, Section 232, IEEPA and re

tools.name: search_tariff_codes
tools.description: Search the U.S. Harmonized Tariff Schedule by product words; returns HTS codes, descriptions and general rates.

tools.name: company_record
tools.description: Everything Starfile holds on one company across agencies: FDA and CPSC recalls, clinical trials it sponsors, nursing homes it owns or runs (CMS), and aircraft registered to it (FAA), with counts, first and last dates and links. Organisations only. Says whether the match is by official id or by name.

tools.description: The dated changes in one official record, newest first, edition by edition as the agency published them: for a nursing home (by CCN) its ratings, staffing, citations, penalties and owner organisations; aircraft (N-number) and trials (NCT id) as their history loads. tools.name: starfile_overview
tools.description: The datasets Starfile holds, how many records each has, how fresh each is, and links to the data feed and docs.

findings.detail: Tool "tariff_duty" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
